title: Edmund Sir Teacher-Approved Grammar Corpus — Release 1
author: Edmund Sir
notes: Initial normalized corpus containing PARA-0001 and PARA-0002.
annotationNotes: Do not mark stylistic preferences as definite grammar mistakes.
Record acceptable alternatives when they are genuinely grammatical.
Include exceptions and correct counterexamples so rules do not become over-broad.
AI output must never enter the approved corpus automatically; teacher review is mandatory.

groups.description: Workplace-uniform paragraph family for approved retrieval examples.
Japan-travel paragraph family for approved retrieval examples.

rules.titleZhHant: many 後使用可數名詞複數
rules.explanationZhHant: many 後面接可數名詞複數。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 複數主語與現在式動詞一致
rules.incorrectPattern: plural subject + present verb ending in s
rules.explanationZhHant: 複數主語在一般現在式中通常配合不加 s 的動詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: staff 的集合名詞用法
rules.incorrectPattern: staffs when referring generally to employees
rules.explanationZhHant: staff 通常是集合名詞。可寫 staff 或 staff members，一般不寫 staffs。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: to 後使用動詞原形
rules.explanationZhHant: 不定詞 to 後面使用動詞原形。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 單數主語與現在式動詞一致
rules.formula: third-person singular subject + present verb ending in s
rules.incorrectPattern: third-person singular subject + base present verb
rules.correctPattern: third-person singular subject + present verb ending in s
rules.explanationZhHant: 第三身單數主語在一般現在式中，動詞通常要加 s 或使用相應的單數形式。
correctExamples: The design does not suit everyone.
incorrectExamples: The design do not suit everyone.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: several 後使用可數名詞複數
rules.explanationZhHant: several 後面要接可數名詞複數。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 泛指群體時使用複數名詞
rules.incorrectPattern: bare singular countable noun used for a general group
rules.correctPattern: plural countable noun used for a general group
rules.explanationZhHant: 泛指某一類人或事物時，通常使用可數名詞複數。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 情態動詞後使用動詞原形
rules.formula: can / could / may / might / should / must + base verb
rules.explanationZhHant: can、may、should 等情態動詞後面，要直接使用最基本的動詞形式，不加 s、ed 或 ing。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: spend money on 的介詞搭配
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示「花錢在某事上」使用 spend money on something。
correctExamples: Staff spend money on work clothes.
incorrectExamples: Staff spend money for work clothes.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: some 泛指可數群體時使用複數
rules.incorrectPattern: some + singular countable noun in a group reference
rules.explanationZhHant: some 泛指一群可數的人或事物時，後面的名詞使用複數。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 共用情態動詞的平行結構
rules.formula: modal + base verb + and + base verb
rules.incorrectPattern: modal + base verb + and + inflected verb
rules.correctPattern: modal + base verb + and + base verb
rules.explanationZhHant: 情態動詞同時控制兩個並列動詞時，兩個動詞都使用原形。
correctExamples: Companies should provide uniforms and allow choices.
incorrectExamples: Companies should provide uniforms and allows choices.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 介詞後使用動名詞
rules.explanationZhHant: 介詞後面的動作通常使用動名詞形式。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 使用不定詞表達行動目的
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示某個行動的目的時，通常使用 to + 動詞原形。
correctExamples: We travelled to Japan to visit several cities.
incorrectExamples: We travelled to Japan for visit several cities.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: near 直接接地方
rules.explanationZhHant: near 可以直接接地方；也可以使用 close to。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: be 後使用形容詞描述狀態
rules.explanationZhHant: be 動詞後描述主語狀態時，需要使用形容詞，而不是相關名詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: information 是不可數名詞
rules.correctPattern: much information or pieces of information
rules.explanationZhHant: information 在一般英文中是不可數名詞，不能直接加 s。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 間接問句使用陳述句語序
rules.formula: reporting verb + question word + subject + auxiliary/verb
rules.incorrectPattern: ask + question word + auxiliary + subject + verb
rules.explanationZhHant: 間接問句不是獨立問題，因此使用陳述句語序。疑問詞後面先寫主語，再寫動詞。
incorrectExamples: She asked where should we go.
I do not know what does he want.
Can you tell me when will the lesson start?
correctExamples: She asked where we should go.
I do not know what he wants.
Can you tell me when the lesson will start?
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: suggest 的句型
rules.formula: suggest that + subject + base verb / suggest + verb-ing
rules.correctPattern: suggest that someone do or suggest doing
rules.explanationZhHant: suggest 通常使用 suggest that + 主語 + 動詞，或者 suggest + verb-ing。不要直接寫 suggest someone to do。
correctExamples: They suggested that we visit the temple.
incorrectExamples: They suggested us to visit the temple.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 關係子句中的被動語態
rules.incorrectPattern: thing + that + past participle without be
rules.explanationZhHant: 主語是動作的承受者時，關係子句需要使用 be + 過去分詞的被動語態。
correctExamples: a temple that was built five hundred years ago
incorrectExamples: a temple that built five hundred years ago
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 描述下雨時使用形式主語 it
rules.explanationZhHant: 描述正在下雨時，最自然的主語通常是形式主語 it。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 副詞放在適當位置修飾動詞
rules.incorrectPattern: manner adverb before the target verb in this construction
rules.explanationZhHant: 副詞修飾動作的程度或方式時，要放在合適的位置。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 第三條件句的結果部分
rules.formula: If + had + past participle, would have + past participle
rules.incorrectPattern: If + had + past participle, would + past form
rules.correctPattern: If + had + past participle, would have + past participle
rules.explanationZhHant: 第三條件句談論未發生的過去情況；結果部分通常使用 would have + 過去分詞。
correctExamples: If we had brought an umbrella, we would not have got wet.
incorrectExamples: If we had brought an umbrella, we would not got wet.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 敘述過去事件時保持並列動詞時態一致
rules.incorrectPattern: past verb + and + base present verb in a past narrative
rules.explanationZhHant: 同一過去敘述中的並列動作，通常使用一致的過去式。
correctExamples: The journey gave us memories and broadened our knowledge.
incorrectExamples: The journey gave us memories and broaden our knowledge.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

paragraphs.title: Workplace Uniforms
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: In recent years, many company requires their staffs to wears uniforms at work. This policy have several advantage for both workers and customer. First, customers can identifies employees quickly, especially when they needs help. Second, a uniform can reduces how much money staff spend for work clothes. However, some employee feels uncomfortable because the same design do not suit everyone. Uniforms may also makes workers feel that they has less personal freedom. In my opinion, companies should provides suitable uniforms and allows employees to choose between several styles, so the policy can remain professional without caused unnecessary discomfort at work.
paragraphs.correctedParagraph: In recent years, many companies require their staff to wear uniforms at work. This policy has several advantages for both workers and customers. First, customers can identify employees quickly, especially when they need help. Second, a uniform can reduce how much money staff spend on work clothes. However, some employees feel uncomfortable because the same design does not suit everyone. Uniforms may also make workers feel that they have less personal freedom. In my opinion, companies should provide suitable uniforms and allow employees to choose between several styles, so the policy can remain professional without causing unnecessary discomfort at work.
paragraphs.author: Edmund Sir

paragraphs.title: A Family Trip to Japan
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: Last summer, my family travelled to Japan for visit several cities. We stayed in a hotel which was located near from the railway station, so travelling was very convenience. On the first day, we collected many informations from a tourist centre and asked the staff where should we go. They suggested us to visit an ancient temple that built over five hundred years ago. Although the weather was heavily raining, the temple was more beautiful than I expected. If we had brought an umbrella, we would not got wet. Overall, the journey gave us many memory and broaden our knowledge.
paragraphs.correctedParagraph: Last summer, my family travelled to Japan to visit several cities. We stayed in a hotel which was located near the railway station, so travelling was very convenient. On the first day, we collected much information from a tourist centre and asked the staff where we should go. They suggested that we visit an ancient temple that was built over five hundred years ago. Although it was raining heavily, the temple was more beautiful than I expected. If we had brought an umbrella, we would not have got wet. Overall, the journey gave us many memories and broadened our knowledge.
paragraphs.author: Edmund Sir
paragraphs.notes: Travel vocabulary with infinitive, preposition, countability, indirect-question, passive and conditional errors.

issues.explanationZhHant: many 後面的可數名詞通常要用複數，所以寫 companies。
companies 是複數主語，現在式動詞用 require，不加 s。
staff 通常是集合名詞。可寫 staff 或 staff members，一般不寫 staffs。
to 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 to wear。
policy 是第三身單數，所以使用 has。
several 後面要接可數名詞複數，所以是 advantages。
這裡泛指顧客這個群體，所以使用 customers。
can 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 can identify。
they 是複數主語，所以使用 need，不加 s。
can 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 can reduce。
表示「花錢在某事上」使用 spend money on something。
這裡泛指部分員工，所以使用 some employees。
employees 是複數，因此使用 feel。
design 是第三身單數，因此使用 does not。
may 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 may make。
they 是複數主語，因此使用 have。
should 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 should provide。
should 同時控制 provide 和 allow，兩個動詞都要使用原形。
without 是介詞，後面的動作通常使用動名詞，所以是 without causing。
表示「前往日本是為了參觀城市」，通常使用 to + 動詞原形 表達目的，所以寫 to visit。
near 可以直接接地方，所以寫 near the railway station。也可以寫 close to the railway station。
convenience 是名詞；這裡放在 was very 後面，需要形容詞 convenient。
information 在一般英文中是不可數名詞，不能寫 informations。可以寫 much information、a lot of information 或 several pieces of information。
這是放在 asked 後面的間接問句，使用陳述句語序：where + 主語 + 動詞。
suggest 通常使用 suggest that + 主語 + 動詞，或者 suggest + verb-ing。不要直接寫 suggest someone to do。
寺廟是「被建造」，所以需要被動語態 was built。
描述正在下雨時，最自然的主語通常是形式主語 it：It was raining.
heavily 修飾下雨的程度，通常放在 raining 後面：raining heavily。
前面使用 If + had + 過去分詞，結果部分通常使用 would have + 過去分詞。
many 後面接可數名詞複數，所以寫 many memories。
整段描述去年的旅程；gave 和 broadened 是兩個並列的過去式動作。

exceptions.conditionEn: for + verb-ing can describe the intended use of an object.
exceptions.exampleText: This bag is for carrying books.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: for + verb-ing 可以表示物件的用途。這不等於「某人做某事的目的」。

exceptions.conditionEn: near to is valid in some abstract or formal contexts.
exceptions.exampleText: The negotiations were near to completion.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: near to 在部分語境可以成立，因此系統不應一律刪除 to。near from 才是本例的問題。

exceptions.conditionEn: The noun convenience is grammatical when the syntax requires a noun.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: convenience 作名詞時完全正確；本例錯在 was very convenience 需要形容詞。

exceptions.conditionEn: Information can be counted with a unit expression.
exceptions.exampleText: We received three pieces of information.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: 需要計算資料數量時，可以使用 pieces/items of information。

exceptions.conditionEn: A directly quoted question retains question word order.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: 直接引述問題時使用疑問句語序；只有間接問句使用 where we should go。

exceptions.conditionEn: suggest + verb-ing is a valid construction.
suggest to someone that... is valid when to introduces the recipient.
exceptions.exampleText: They suggested to us that we visit the temple.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: suggest to someone that... 可以成立，但不能寫 suggest someone to do。

exceptions.conditionEn: Use the active voice when the relative-clause subject performs the action.
exceptions.exampleText: We met the workers who built the temple.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: workers 主動建造寺廟，所以使用主動式 built，不需要 were built。

exceptions.conditionEn: The weather can be the subject when rainy is an adjective.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: 使用形容詞 rainy 時，可以用 the weather 作主語。

exceptions.conditionEn: A mixed conditional can combine a past condition with a present result.
exceptions.exampleText: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: 這是混合條件句：過去條件造成現在結果，因此可以使用 would be。

exceptions.conditionEn: American English commonly uses gotten as the past participle of get.
exceptions.exampleText: If we had brought an umbrella, we would not have gotten wet.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: gotten 是常見美式英文；got 是本例採用的英式英文。

exceptions.conditionEn: The formal many a construction takes a singular noun and singular verb.
exceptions.exampleText: Many a traveller has made this mistake.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: 正式結構 many a + 單數名詞 + 單數動詞 是例外。

exceptions.conditionEn: A modal changes the required form of the following verb.
exceptions.exampleText: The journey may broaden our knowledge.
exceptions.explanationZhHant: 情態動詞 may 後面使用動詞原形，所以這裡的 broaden 正確。
